honest_framing: A size test of the v0.60.0 method, expected to be hard: the probe decided 1 of 4 at 24 states, so the headline gate (2 of 6) is roughly a coin flip under the probe rate. A pass means some 2-bit 24-state worlds are decided by this solver under a declared N 24; a fail is published plainly as 'the method does not yet scale to 24 states at 2 bits at 8M'. The replication arm and the new reference decide whether 2-bit N <= 20 becomes certified.
